# Code of conduct

We want this project to be a friendly place to ask questions and contribute.

- Be respectful. Disagree with ideas, not people.
- No harassment, insults, or discrimination of any kind.
- Assume good intent, and explain your reasoning.
- Keep discussion on topic and in public, except for security reports (see SECURITY.md).

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close issues, or block people who break these rules. To report a problem, contact the maintainer through a private GitHub security advisory or the email on their profile.

This text is adapted from the spirit of the Contributor Covenant 2.1 (https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
